_comment: The installer's catalogue of EXTERNAL plugins (`install.sh --with <id>`). In-repo builtins are NOT listed here: ship.json (or an optional extension's own ship.json) + release.json decide those. An entry is installable only with listed:true; listed:false is a known id the installer refuses in words. `ref` is a commit sha, never a branch: what the installer checks out is exactly what was verified. Copilot is listed after its real check on 1.0.91 (2026-10-02); its repo is private until the public release, so until then only an authenticated clone can fetch it.

plugins.name: GitHub Copilot CLI backend
